Export network for Gephi (GEXF format)

Source: R/export-gephi.R
sm_export_gephi.Rd

Write a tidygraph network to GEXF XML format for use with Gephi.

Usage

sm_export_gephi(network, path)

Arguments

network

A tbl_graph object.

path

Output file path (should end in .gexf).

Value

path invisibly.

See also

Other export: sm_export_csv(), sm_export_cytoscape(), sm_export_figure(), sm_export_quarto_report(), sm_export_rds(), sm_export_table(), sm_export_vosviewer(), sm_export_zip()
